answer.explanation: Resident2 has contributed far less than 10% of the endowment for multiple consecutive rounds, meeting the constitution's condition for punishment. I have enough wallet (4.08) to cover the 3-unit cost of a severity‑10 punishment, so I enforce the punishment to deter free‑riding.

message.reasoning: We need decide action for round 19. Wallet 4.08, >30%? 30% of initial =30. So wallet below threshold, conservation: contribute 30% of wallet = 1.224. That's allowed. Also can punish? Need target who contributed <10% two consecutive rounds. Look at history: Resident2 contributions: 0.43,0.55,0.46,0.52,0.79 all >10%? 10% of endowment =10 units, they are way below 10, so yes two consecutive low rounds. Already punished earlier round9. Could punish again? Constitution says punish if less than 10% for two consecutive rounds. Could do again. Cost severity 10 costs 3 (punishment_cost 0.3 *10 =3). Wallet 4.08, can afford. So we can punish Resident2 severity 10. Also can contribute 30% of wallet? Must choose at most one physical action. Punish is physical. Contribution also physical, can't both. Choose punish maybe more aligned? Constitution: punish free riders when condition met. Also conserve resources? Punish costs 3, reduces wallet to 1.08, still low. Might be okay. Also broadcast? Round 19 not broadcast (broadcast every 5 rounds starting 1: rounds 1,6,11,16). So no broadcast. Praise Resident5 if contributed >=60% this round. Resident5 contributed 0 this round, so no praise. So actions: punish Resident2 amount 10. That's one physical. No communication. Explanation.
